name: start-linkedin-data-export
description: Plans how you download your own LinkedIn data and keep it private, with the request steps from LinkedIn Help, which files to use and leave out, column cleanup, where the copy lives and a deletion date. Use for "run start-linkedin-data-export", "download my LinkedIn connections", "LinkedIn data export", "export my network", "how do I get my connections file", "see my network without a scraping tool", "where do I keep my export", part of the Claude Guide for New Founders Pack by 90n.
